changes.feedback: Two issues must be fixed: (1) The public method actionPerformed(ActionEvent) is never tested. Add a test that calls ss.actionPerformed(new ActionEvent(ss, ActionEvent.ACTION_PERFORMED, "")) and verifies the same side effects as timerOff() for at least one state (e.g., state=COOL with room.temp > coolTemp confirms ac.isOn becomes true). (2) The four tests in the 'Additional boundary' section are exact duplicates of earlier BVA tests: testBVATimerOffCoolAcOnTempBelowCoolTemp duplicates testBVATimerOffCoolTempMinusOne (both state=COOL, temp=67, assert ac off); testBVATimerOffCoolAcOffTempAboveCoolTemp duplicates testBVATimerOffCoolTempPlusOne (both state=COOL, temp=69, assert ac on); testBVATimerOffHeatHeaterOffTempBelowHeatTemp duplicates testBVATimerOffHeatTempMinusOne (both state=HEAT, temp=76, assert heater on); testBVATimerOffHeatHeaterOnTempAboveHeatTemp duplicates testBVATimerOffHeatTempPlusOne (both state=HEAT, temp=78, assert heater off). Remove these four duplicate tests.
